Instantly restores %(immediatelyRestore)s of the vehicle's hit points. Reducing your gun dispersion is critical: the smaller the initial dispersion, the smaller the aiming circle and the quicker you can fully aim your gun. In addition, an unprepared shot (that is fired without fully aiming or on the move) will have a better chance of hitting the target.
%s to dispersion after firing, during movement and turret rotation with Vertical Stabilizer, Stabilizing Equipment System, or Bounty Stabilizer mounted.

Improves the effect of the stabilizer

Spall liners absorb damage; this means they reduce the damage from ramming and High-Explosive shells. Spall liners will be beneficial to heavy tanks with reliable armor and huge ramming potential that fight mainly in close combat.
Protects the vehicle and crew from HE shells, injuries, stunning, and ramming
Commands artillery to fire down on a small area with HE shells. Vehicles in the center of the impact receive the most damage. Particularly effective against heavily armored vehicles.
Causes considerable damage to enemy vehicles within a small radius.
%(vehicleFireChance)s to the chance of engine fire
Automatic fire extinguishing in your vehicle.
Automatically extinguishes fire and reduces the chance of the vehicle catching fire. This consumable is suitable for all vehicle types of any nation.
Automatic fire extinguishing in your vehicle. Can be used multiple times in a battle. The consumable is removed after a battle if it was used at least once.

Increases penetration and fire rate by %(gunPiercing)s times, while also increasing gun laying efficiency and stabilization by %(gunAimingTime)s, but takes away %(healthDebuff)s of your vehicle's total HP within its %(duration)s s duration.

*Damage caused by the Berserker ability cannot destroy your vehicle.

Allows you to get back to battle after your vehicle is destroyed. This mechanic works within the first %(duration)s min of a battle.

To respawn an ally, stay out of combat for %(timeToResurrect)s s. Respawn charges are shared between Platoon members.

Allows you to get back to battle after your vehicle has been destroyed. This mechanic works within the first %(duration)s min of a battle.

Repairs all damaged modules at once upon activation. The passive effect increases the repair speed. This consumable is suitable for certain vehicles.

Increases the concealment of a stationary vehicle 3 s after it stops

Unlike Binocular Telescope, Coated Optics (of any type) provides a smaller yet permanent bonus that does not disappear with vehicle movement. As a result, Coated Optics is highly beneficial for vehicles with active gameplay—light and medium tanks.

*The negative effect can be removed by a Repair Kit.

An enhanced version of Low Noise Exhaust System that provides a stronger effect: increases the concealment of a stationary or moving vehicle. Useful for active spotting, as well as for passive spotting from risky positions.
This equipment is suitable for vehicles of all nations and types, but its effectiveness depends on the vehicle type. Can only be demounted using bonds.

{colorTagOpen}+17.5{colorTagClose}/{colorTagOpen}12.5{colorTagClose}/{colorTagOpen}7.5%{colorTagClose} to concealment of a stationary vehicle

Increases vehicle durability and protects suspension

An enhanced version of Improved Aiming that provides a stronger effect: reduces the size of the aiming circle of an aiming or fully aimed gun by {colorTagOpen}9%{colorTagClose}. An improved version of Binocular Telescope. A good view range provides a solid advantage to vehicles in battle. This type of equipment is beneficial for tank destroyers with low silhouettes and accurate guns. It activates 1.5 seconds after the vehicle stops moving.
